uncultured.finding: An independent museum-object photograph is front-facing, close, and visually isolates two wooden figures from most contextual clutter. This weakens any universal claim that the user's images characteristically preserve heavy acquisition traces.
uncultured.candidate: At least two capture modes may coexist: retaining environmental/acquisition traces and deliberately isolating an object from context.
uncultured.next: sample more independent camera sessions to test whether this is a stable bimodal habit or merely subject-driven variation

terminus.status: METHOD REFINEMENT · QUALITY MUST BE GENRE-AWARE
terminus.finding: A named field note on a community-course visit has high observational value despite not being a theory paper: it preserves chronology, actors, competing interpretations and concrete interactions. A cultural-heritage research-report catalog has little argument but strong indexing value because it maps research topics, institutions, investigators and report structures. Applying one generic 'argument quality' score would misclassify both.
terminus.candidate: Evaluate material after genre identification. Reusable value should be multidimensional: argument, evidence/data, observation, index/navigation, originality/problem formation. Authorship remains provenance, not a quality shortcut.
terminus.next: continue seeking clearly student-authored work and compare its usable dimensions without author-status bias; skip obvious private administrative/credential records from conceptual mining

phase: small-batch mining with genre-aware multidimensional quality scoring
